period.note: The lecture centers on August 1945 and follows surrender through the formal September 2 instrument. Earlier military context and later testimony dates are distinct from the events covered.

description: Examines japanese surrender, the atomic attacks, Soviet entry, imperial decision-making, civilian testimony, and the limits of counterfactual history.
